status: development; no physical specimen or force qualification
architecture: Transverse constant-section root beam with two full axial-strain bridges; all finger loads enter through its floating end

notes: The transverse orientation converts the long-finger normal-load moment mainly into beam torsion; two symmetric gauges on each face aim to cancel torsional warping in each bridge.
Normal force is recovered from the difference of calibrated bending measurements, with all loads entering beyond both stations through the floating carrier.
Three-dimensional strain, torsion, fixture compliance, cross-axis response and physical moment rejection require verification.
Gauge width positions approximate two-point cross-section averaging, accounting for the finite 3.05 mm grid width; robustness still requires the three-dimensional screen and measurement.
The earlier 18 mm active longitudinal coupon is retained in engineering/concepts; it is not this revision.

gauges.adhesive_for_initial_bench_build: Micro-Measurements M-Bond 200; follow current manufacturer preparation and cure instructions
gauges.surface_protection_candidate: Micro-Measurements M-Coat A; characterize its effect and follow manufacturer instructions

bridge_wiring.R1: top face, negative local width position; E+ to S+
bridge_wiring.R2: bottom face, same negative local width position; S+ to E-
bridge_wiring.R3: bottom face, positive local width position; E+ to S-
bridge_wiring.R4: top face, same positive local width position; S- to E-

gauges.alignment: Grid long axes parallel to the beam axis. Align the active grid center, not the center of the asymmetric backing. Point station-1 tabs toward the fixed end and station-2 tabs toward the floating end.
notes: S-T-C 13 is selected for aluminum; actual gauge factor and thermal-output data come from the purchased lot.
The conservative envelope permits the complete 7.9 mm backing on either side of the grid center, without assuming an undocumented grid-to-backing offset.
The gauge backing is 7.9 by 4.8 mm; the larger CAD keepout is an assembly allowance, not the physical sensor size.
No bonded-gauge sensitivity, drift, creep or fatigue performance has been measured.

mount.fixed_m3_head: 90-degree flat head with measured head diameter at most 6.0 mm, seated flush
mount.m4_screw: M4 x 25, fully threaded, with measured 1.0 mm washer thickness
notes: The fixed and floating carriers must never touch across the active load path.
The printed pieces are for fit review; machine the beam, carriers and clamp caps from the specified metal before force tests.
Check actual drive housing and fastener engagement. No drive-specific fit or joint torque qualification is established.
The fixed clearance version uses flush flat-head M3 screws; ordinary protruding socket heads would collide with the floating-side rear hardware at this reach extension.
All cable routing must retain slack and avoid a parallel force path.

readout.clock: Common 6.25 MHz RP2040 PIO clock and shared power-down control; calculated conversion rate 101.725 Hz
readout.reference: Each bridge excitation is also its ADC reference

structural_screen.clamp_model: Bonded beam/carrier/cap interfaces, fixed original-jaw contact face and rigid floating finger interface; actual fastener preload, friction and slip must be measured
required_checks: mesh convergence of displacement and gauge-area averages
normal-force recovery and independent end-moment rejection
gauge position and gain mismatch sensitivity
installed carrier geometry and load-path separation
